The worst meal I've had in Vietnam
Oct 2022 • Couples
It's hard to know where to start with how bad this restaurant is. The staff didn't care and we had to ask for service multiple times. When we got our glasses of wine they were old vinegar and the red wine was kept in the fridge and was freezing. The food was awful, my wife's pasta had clearly been in the microwave multiple times and had a thick skin on it. We said we are leaving barely touching anything and they refused to let us leave, I asked to speak to the manager who refused to come downstairs to talk to me but had someone guard over me until I gave them most of the bill. 

There are so many good places in this city for food, love yourself and don't make the mistake I made and go anywhere else.

Terrible Dinning Experience
Jun 2019 • Friends
I hosted a surprised birthday dinner for my friend and her kids. After dinner at the resturant, we took out a cake to surpise my friend. We asked for some new plates but the staff served us with plastic spoons and refused to provide us with a knife to cut the cake.

What was a happy atmosphere quickly changed when i had to walk up to another staff who gave me a knife from another table setting. 

From my dinning experience in Vietnam and other similar resturants in Asia, this the worst dinning experience and we WILL NEVER come back. As for the price and quality of food, please read the already poor comments from other diners. I should have taken heed to it before comming.

Thank you.
